name: Seth Zerdowski
role: Seventeen-year-old / the kid by the lake
powers: Solar-plasma exposure grants incredible strength and durability. Flight emerges later. Learning to use any of it takes practice.
personality: Kind, clumsy, determined and self-doubting. He wants to do good, find his place and prove he belongs.
relationships: Inspector Billy eventually follows the same mystery. Doc Dork covets the energy that changed Seth. The team has not yet assembled.
appearances: Chapter 3: The Kid by the Lake
quote: I mess up a lot… but I still show up.
